title: Show aggregate optimization status and expandable score details
description:
As an optimization stakeholder, I want the living Report to summarize portfolio status at a glance and let me expand scorecard and score details, so that I can understand the run without opening raw evidence first.

Out of scope:
- New GraphQL models or infrastructure resources.
- Eagerly loading every score detail.
- Limiting how many sections a user may expand.

Feature: Glanceable optimization Report

Scenario: Understand aggregate progress at a glance
Given a living optimization Report has a published revision
When a stakeholder opens the Report
Then the top section shows lifecycle, coverage, work completed, primary decision mix, top priorities, pending actions, and the next checkpoint
And every visual has a text or table equivalent

Scenario: Reconcile primary decision totals
Given each score may have several overlapping findings
When the Report builds the primary decision chart
Then every score appears in exactly one primary next-action category
And secondary overlapping issue counts are shown separately

Scenario: Expand scorecards and scores on demand
Given the portfolio contains many scorecards and scores
When a stakeholder expands one or more scorecards
Then each remains independently expanded
And score rows and artifact links load on demand
And expanding a score reveals its rationale, evidence, and next action

Scenario: Explain incomplete termination
Given a run stops with incomplete evidence or a configured work limit
When the Report reaches that state
Then the overview prominently explains why it stopped
And states the next operator action

Scenario: Preserve accessible alternatives
Given aggregate charts are displayed
When a user cannot interpret or access the chart
Then equivalent labeled counts and descriptions remain available

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented the first aggregate living-report presentation checkpoint: mutually exclusive primary-decision counts with separate overlapping issue counts, glanceable lifecycle and coverage metrics, top priorities, independently expandable scorecards, on-demand score-detail loading, and exact-revision Markdown/CSV links. Focused validation is green: 46 Python report/orchestration tests, 10 dashboard artifact/report tests, and dashboard TypeScript compilation. No Amplify resources or schema were changed. Next: commit this checkpoint, visually exercise it with a fresh local run, then add action-worthy per-score narrative artifacts and refine any usability defects found.
